newsitem.title: INDIA: India allocates rice, wheat for subsidised sales.
newsitem.headline: India allocates rice, wheat for subsidised sales.

text.p: The Indian government has made an additional allocation of 158,000 tonnes of rice and 83,000 tonnes of wheat to 20 states for subsidised sale through public rationing in August, the Food Ministry said on Tuesday.
The government has also allocated an additional 162,000 tonnes of rice and 103,000 tonnes of wheat for September.
The statement did not give initial allocation figures for the months.

"Request for additional allocations of foodgrains from the states are considered by the centre on the basis of availability of rice and wheat for distribution under the public distribution system as well as to meet the demands for flood relief and festivals," the statement added. -- New Delhi Newsroom (91) 11-301-2024; Fax (91) 11-301-4043
